result.question: What did the people of Dan want the Levite to ask God?

readings.answer: Whether they would have a successful journey.
readings.support: Please inquire of God to determine whether we will have a successful journey.

assessments.reason: The passage states, “Please inquire of God to determine whether we will have a successful journey,” which matches the key’s wording about asking if their journey would be successful.

result.reason: Verse 18:5 explicitly asks the Levite to inquire of God whether their journey would be successful.
